description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Compare every live intent in .fixmap/intents/, plus an optional saved plan as a proposal, and report overlapping files and who holds them. Same-file edits and edits into another intent's impact or contract zone block; disjoint line ranges and different base commits are warnings. Read-only.

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

report.description: Path to a saved FixMap JSON plan to check as a proposal
